name: The four vowels the rest of the game could not reach
WHY_THIS_FILE_EXISTS: ঈ ঊ ঐ ঔ had no level anywhere: not in the uploaded curriculum, and not buildable from the
curated pool, which held only ঈগল ঈদ ঊনিশ ঊষা ঐক্য ঔষধ between them - two words a letter at
best, where a level needs three. These levels use words sourced for the purpose and checked
against corpus frequency, the lowest being ঊরু at zipf 2.31.
ঔষধ is not here even though it is the obvious ঔ word. It is the same word as ওষুধ, spelled
the other way, and ওষুধ is already on the ও level - no word goes on two boards.
READ_THIS_BEFORE_SHIPPING_ঐ_AND_ঔ: ঈ and ঊ are honest levels. ঈগল is an eagle, ঈদ is Eid, ঈদগাহ is the ground Eid prayers are
held on, ঊরু is a thigh, ঊষা is dawn, ঊনিশ is nineteen. A child meets all of those.
ঐ and ঔ are not, and the reason is the language rather than the curation: word-initial ঐ and
ঔ in Bengali are almost entirely abstract Sanskritic nouns carrying heavy conjuncts - ক্য,
তিহ্য, চ্ছি, জ্জ্ব, দ্ধ, ত্য. There is no concrete alternative to choose instead. ঐরাবত, the
white elephant of the myths, would have been drawable and is a real word, but the corpus puts
it at zipf 1.75, under the floor everything else here clears.
So these two levels teach the letter and nothing a seven-year-old can picture. That may still
be worth it - the letters are in the alphabet the game claims to cover - but it is a
deliberate trade, not an oversight, and they are the two levels to cut first.
